errorSignature: Unreachable email validation in LoginForm.tsx blur handler
rootCause: HTML5 type="email" inputs evaluate e.target.value as an empty string if the content is an invalid email, causing string prototype checks like .includes('@') to silently skip.
resolution: Updated the onBlur handler to check e.target.validity.typeMismatch instead of purely relying on e.target.value string methods.
preventionRule: When handling onChange or onBlur for HTML5 specific inputs (like type="email"), utilize the Constraint Validation API (e.target.validity) instead of parsing e.target.value directly.
